comparability_notes: AMD reports US GAAP in USD; TSMC reports IFRS in New Taiwan dollars. Preserve original currencies; do not compare nominal levels without declared FX handling.
AMD FY2023 is 52 weeks from 2023-01-01 through 2023-12-30; TSMC annual reporting year ends 2023-12-31. TSMC start is a reviewer calendar-year interpretation rather than an extracted inline context.
TSMC US$ columns are convenience translations at NT$30.62 per US$1.00, not original reporting currency. Native NT$ columns retain one decimal in millions.

Operating cash flow is the reported net operating cash flow. TSMC reports interest received in investing and interest paid in financing in the cited statement; no accounting-standard harmonization is attempted.

Capex here means cash acquisitions/purchases of PP&E, a positive payment magnitude with its negative statement sign retained. TSMC cash payment 949816.8 million differs from PP&E additions 897557.1 million and from net investing cash outflow; disposal proceeds and government grants are separately reported.
Ending cash is the balance-sheet cash and cash equivalents line. Do not use AMD cash/cash-equivalents/restricted-cash combined ending line or add short-term investments.
Numerically correct manual source reading does not create reviewed DB records or establish full financial package coverage.

currency_evidence.quote: We publish our financial statements in New Taiwan dollars, the lawful currency of the R.O.C. In this annual report, “$,” “US$” and “U.S. dollars” mean United States dollars, the lawful currency of the United States, and “NT$” and “NT dollars” mean New Taiwan dollars. This annual report contains translations of certain NT dollar amounts into U.S. dollars at specified rates solely for the convenience of the reader. Unless otherwise noted, all translations from NT dollars to U.S. dollars in this annual report were made at NT$30.62 to US$1.00, the exchange rate set forth in the H.10 statistical release of the Federal Reserve Board on December 29, 2023.

TSMC and its subsidiaries (collectively as the “Company”) maintain its accounts and express its consolidated financial statements in New Taiwan dollars. For convenience only, U.S. dollar amounts presented in the accompanying consolidated financial statements have been translated from New Taiwan dollars at the exchange rate as set forth in the statistical release of the Federal Reserve Board of the Unites States, which was NT$30.62 to US$1.00 as of December 29, 2023. The convenience translations should not be construed as representations that the New Taiwan dollar amounts have been, could have been, or could in the future be, converted into U.S. dollars at this or any other rate of exchange.
